content_blocks.label: clause_1._Definition_of_Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means all information disclosed by the Disclosing Party, whether written, oral, electronic, or any other form.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Obligations_of_Receiving_Party
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall keep all Confidential Information strictly confidential and not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Term
content_blocks.text: This agreement shall remain in effect until the expiration of five (5) years from the date of this agreement.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 20th day of April 2024.
